name: m4-whs-hash-pekko
description: Does comparing `Entry.hash` before `equals` in `WeakHashSet`'s chain walks help? Without it every chain entry loads its referent and runs `elem.equals`. Instrumented compiles (one full compile): pekko 2.34M lookups visit 2.14M entries, of which 573k (26.7%) would be rejected by the hash; see the session's report for scala.
`base` and `baseaa` are the same build of `upstream/2.13.x`, the A/A control. Release optimizer settings (`SCALA_RELEASE_OPT`); patched JDK 26, 8G heap; xctrace ipc for cycles and instructions.

variantDescriptions.proto: `base` plus the hash check in `findEntry`, `findEntryOrUpdate`, `addOne` and `subtractOne`
